bio: Kavitha & Associates is an independent Chartered Accountancy practice led by CA Kavitha Vijay. An MNC Auditor with Big 4 Experience of 10+ Years across Deloitte and Ford Motor Company, the practice combines statutory assurance, enterprise risk management, direct taxation, GST compliance, and corporate governance with internal operational cost controls. Operating from primary chambers in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, every client engagement receives direct, partner-level technical supervision.
complianceStatement: As per the code of ethics and guidelines issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), this profile is intended solely to provide factual information regarding the firm's practice areas and accredited qualifications.
